name: after the focus moves from A to B, B is served at whole story and A is still served (at least one line); B's depth is never below A's (M214/M282)

seed.content: Layout: three cedar raised beds along the south fence, a 90 cm gravel path, a seating corner under the fig with a bench facing west
Irrigation: drip lines on a timer fed from two rain barrels, with a bypass valve for the hose in dry weeks

rounds.user: The beds will be 45 cm high.
The timer runs at 6 am for twenty minutes.
